additional_info.subject: RE: ID0442070-DC/SI-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002726]OCPP modem is not connected CRM:02678000173
additional_info.body:
Hello Luca,
Upon reviewing the logs, we observed multiple instances of HTTP 404 errors around 17:25 on 5th August 2025. These errors indicate that the charge point attempted to reach a backend resource that was not found, resulting in a failed connection.
Additionally, earlier log entries show that the charge point was undergoing network reconfiguration, including updates to SIM card parameters and WAN protocol settings. It is likely that during this transition, the charge point temporarily lost connectivity or attempted to reach the backend before the network settings were fully applied.
The charge point has now established a stable OCPP connection with the backend, No further errors have been observed since the network settings were applied.
If the issue reoccurs, we will proceed to check the router settings and perform a deeper network-level analysis.
Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
